description: This Java interface 'Feature' defines the contract for managing data and functionality associated with a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing, copying, accessing, and modifying feature properties, definitions, and JSON representations, as well as nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Feature.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested static final class defining known JSON field definitions related to Feature's schema version, definition, and properties.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for creating an immutable Feature instance from scratch.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a copy of this Feature with its current values for modification.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of this Feature.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Returns a copy of this Feature with the specified FeatureDefinition attached.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Returns a copy of this Feature without a FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves the optional properties associated with this Feature.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Returns a copy of this Feature with the specified properties.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Returns a copy of this Feature with all properties removed.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property via JSON pointer or string path.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets the value of a property specified by JSON pointer or string path, with overloads for primitive types.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a property specified by JSON pointer or string path.
